facts.business: The Grob Tea Company Limited is engaged in the cultivation, production, and sale of tea, including CTC and Orthodox varieties, from its tea estates in Assam and Cachar.

capacity_or_capex.item: New Orthodox Factory at Pathemara T.E.
capacity_or_capex.timeline: Expected to go into production by end of August 2026

guidance_or_targets.statement: Current season 2026 crop ahead in all gardens; Doyang and Dessoi gardens ahead by 64% and 66% respectively

auditor.name: B Nath & Company, Chartered Accountants (Firm Registration No. 307075E)
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter: The Company has entered into the business of LED Lights in an earlier year with no sale of LED products during last four years. The total investment in the said LED Light Business as on March 31, 2026 is 119.77 Lakhs which includes only stocks at Net Realisable Value. The management is confident of recovery of the said amount in due course and no further provision is considered necessary for any possible losses that may arise in this behalf.

key_risks: Erratic weather conditions and global warming impacting tea production and quality
Decline in average sale price realization due to supply-demand dynamics
Investment in LED Light business with no sales for four years and uncertain recovery
Significant judgement involved in valuation of biological assets and agricultural produce
facts.related_party_note: Inter Corporate Deposit - Related Party of Rs. 690.00 Lakhs as at 31st March 2026 (Rs. 4,395.00 Lakhs as at 31st March 2025)
